Hi Ava —

So sorry about the missed review. We had an unexpected all-hands that ran into the slot and our procurement lead (Ben) was pulled into it. That's on us.

I've attached our initial redlines and comments (Crestpoint_redlines_20261115.docx). There are three priority asks:
- Data retention: need a 7-year option and logs retention for compliance team
- Audit: annual SOC-type review report delivery and on-demand audit support windows
- Liability: cap language clarification tied to term and usage levels

Our preference is a short walkthrough this week; Thurs or Fri morning PT would be best. If possible, include someone who can speak to SOC/controls and to pricing impact of retention changes.

Also — would you be able to share a DocuSign link or a redline-ready SOW after we align? That will speed approvals.

Apologies again for the no-show. Looking forward to rebooking.

Best,
Iris Monroe
Head of Legal Operations
Crestpoint Financial
iris.monroe@crestpoint.com
